description: Permanently removes a specific `color` label from an existing Trello card identified by `idCard`, if the card has that label; this only disassociates the label from the card, not deleting the label definition itself.

color.description: The specific color of the label to remove from the card. Standard Trello label colors are used (e.g., 'red', 'blue').
color.title: Color

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the Trello card.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: remove_card_label_by_color

RemoveCardLabelByColorResponse.description:
Response schema for `RemoveCardLabelByColor`

The DELETE endpoint returns 200 OK on success with an empty response body.
The endpoint removes the label association from the card.
RemoveCardLabelByColorResponse.title: RemoveCardLabelByColorResponse
